Description: As a Pharmacy Clerk, I want to view the available stock of each medicine, so that I can check availability before dispensing.
As a Pharmacy Clerk, I want to view medicine details including batch and expiry information, so that I can identify the correct stock to dispense.
As a Pharmacy Clerk, I want the system to generate a dispensing list ordered by earliest expiry date, so that medicines closest to expiry are dispensed first.
As a Pharmacy Clerk, I want to record medicine dispensing against the selected batch, so that stock levels remain accurate after each transaction.
As a Pharmacy Administrator, I want the system to identify medicines that reach the re-order threshold, so that low stock can be replenished on time.
As a Pharmacy Administrator, I want the system to generate and send a purchase order to the Inventory Supplier, so that replenishment can begin without manual order preparation.
As a Pharmacy Administrator, I want to set or update the safety-stock threshold for a medicine, so that re-ordering reflects the pharmacy's required minimum stock.
As a Pharmacy Administrator, I want to identify medicines at or below their safety-stock threshold, so that I can monitor items requiring attention.
